text:
Your name, a little pretentious, very pagan,

because it is yours, I find delightful.

In Spanish it means “pretty,” and since you are,

every time it is spoken, the truth is told.


In German that name turns melancholy;

in April’s breeze it murmurs sweetly.

It is a lyrical lime tree, a tree of legend,

from which each night a flock of elves flies out.


At last, that strange name that speaks your beauty

was also the name of a Greek city

that blossomed among Rhodes’ lovely roses,

the island where young doves coo.

translation.title: Words of Love to Linda
